notes.title: Server update notification: Battle Royale and Capture Battle update
notes.content:
Dungeon warriors:
Hello everyone! The server will update within an hour. The main changes in this update are as follows.
1. New passive skills in battle royale mode can be learned by consuming souls at the altar. Souls can be acquired by killing BOSS and other players. Passive skills can strengthen all aspects of the combat, giving you an advantage in the final battle.
2. Capture Battle mode changing from occupying one dreamland gate to occupying multiple dreamland gates. Each of the occupied dreamland gates will generate points, and the team that reaches 100 points first wins. And we have added two maps to Capture Battle mode. There are currently three maps.
This update also fixes some camera control issues.

Happy gaming!
Soulfire Team

notes.title: Server update notice
notes.content:
Dungeon warriors:
Hello everyone! The server is expected to be updated within one hour, and the main balance adjustments are as follows:
1. Melee weapons only consume durability when they hit and cause damage. Air swings no longer consume durability. This change will make melee weapons more durable, and smashing barrels will no longer consume weapon durability.
2. Melee weapon attacks no longer consume stamina, only dodge will consume stamina. This change puts more emphasis on the continuity of offense.
3. When jumping back from the edge of the screen to the center of the screen, the camera no longer follows. This facilitates quick adjustment of the field of view.

Happy gaming!
Soulfire Team
